footer.tagline: Leave, holidays, and HR documents for growing teams.

hero.title: Leave and papers, in one place
hero.description: One link to join your company, one screen to see who is off, one click to request a day off or a document.
hero.imageAlt: Bright open office with desks and natural light

problem.title: Leave still lives in spreadsheets and chat
problem.description: Balances drift, approvals get lost, and employees wait days for a salary certificate. WorkHub replaces the scattered trail with one clear path for every request.

clients.title: Built for teams that outgrew the spreadsheet
clients.description: Studios, clinics, agencies, and growing companies across MENA and francophone markets — without a full HRIS.

stats.title: Built around clear outcomes
stats.description: v1 targets and capacity — sized for small teams, not enterprise sprawl.

items.languages: languages for HR papers (AR, FR, EN)
items.place: for leave, holidays, and HR papers

product.title: Built for how small teams actually work
product.description: Spaces, invites, leave, holidays, and document requests — scoped by role from day one.

leave-bank.title: Leave bank
leave-bank.description: Balances by leave type, with team visibility so planning stays honest.

approvals.title: Approvals with context
approvals.description: Managers decide with comments and a full audit trail of every change.

documents.title: HR papers
documents.description: Work certificates, salary letters, and payslip copies without email chase.

path.title: From invite to decision, without the chase

join.title: Join your space
join.description: Invite link, email invite, or verified company domain.

request.title: Request in one click
request.description: Time off or an HR paper — same clear flow for everyone.

decide.title: Decide with a trail
decide.description: Approve, deny, comment — every decision stays visible.

cta.title: Onboard a 20-person team in under 10 minutes
cta.description: WorkHub is built so leave and document requests move inside the product — with a median decision time under 24 hours.
